summaries.name: The Fly Fishing Academy
summaries.summary: The Fly Fishing Academy (flyfishingacademy.com) offers a comprehensive online course on fly tying, covering basic, intermediate, and advanced techniques.

summaries.name: Fly Tying 101
summaries.summary: Fly Tying 101 (flytying101.com) is a free online guide with step-by-step instructions, videos, and tutorials for beginner fly tying; also a YouTube channel with a vast collection of step-by-step fly tying tutorials.

summaries.name: The Fly Tying Forum
summaries.summary: The Fly Tying Forum (flytyingforum.com) is a community-driven forum with tutorials, patterns, and discussions on various aspects of fly tying.

summaries.name: The Fly Fishing Guide
summaries.summary: The Fly Fishing Guide is a YouTube channel offering a range of fly tying tutorials, from beginner to advanced.

summaries.name: Fly Fishing the Globe
summaries.summary: Fly Fishing the Globe is a YouTube channel featuring fly tying tutorials, fishing trips, and gear reviews.

summaries.name: Shimano Curado
summaries.summary: The user's Shimano Curado rod has a slight crack in the guide (as of 2023-05-20); considering whether to get it repaired (roughly $20-$50) or replace it with a new rod.
